segments.title: Promo type, request and store state
context: A shopper had no place to enter a promo code. The cart now has a field for one above the total. When the server returns a promo for the code, the cart shows the amount taken off and a lower total. When the request for the code fails, the cart says that the code is not valid, and the total stays as it was. Emptying the cart drops the promo.
## Overview

- **When** a shopper opens the cart with at least one item, **then** [the summary shows a promo code field and an Apply button](code:src/routes/cart/components/PromoForm.tsx#PromoForm) above the total.

- **When** a shopper submits a code and the API returns a promo of 10 percent, **then** [the summary shows a Discount line of 10 percent of the total](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L21).
- **When** a promo is applied, **then** [the Total line shows the total minus the discount](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L22).
- **When** the request for a code is running, **then** [the Apply button is disabled](code:src/routes/cart/components/PromoForm.tsx#L17-19).
- **When** the request for a code fails, **then** [the form shows "That code is not valid."](code:src/routes/cart/components/PromoForm.tsx#L20) and the total does not change.
- **When** a shopper empties the cart with "Empty it", **then** [the promo is removed with the items](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L26-28).
- **When** a shopper removes a line with "Remove", **then** [the promo stays applied](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L20-22) to the lines that are left.
- **When** the cart has no items, **then** nothing changes: the page shows "Your cart is empty." and no promo code field.
- **When** a shopper adds a product in the catalogue or reads the item count in the header, **then** nothing changes.
## Implementation
**`src/api/promo.ts`**
- Added [the type `Promo`](code:src/api/promo.ts#Promo) with a `code` and a `percentOff`.
- Added [`fetchPromo()`](code:src/api/promo.ts#fetchPromo) to request `/promos/<code>` and return the `Promo` of the response.
**`src/stores/cart-store.ts`**
- Modified [`CartState`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#CartState) to have `promo` and the action `applyPromo`.
- Modified [`useCartStore`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#useCartStore) to start with `promo: null` and to set `promo` in the new action `applyPromo`.
- Modified [the action `clear`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L26-28) to set `promo` to `null` with `items: []`.
- Added [the constant `PERCENT`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#PERCENT) with the value `100`.
- Added [`selectDiscountCents()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#selectDiscountCents) to return the promo's percentage of the cart total in cents, or `0` when `promo` is `null`.
**`src/hooks/use-promo.ts`**
- Added [`useApplyPromo()`](code:src/hooks/use-promo.ts#useApplyPromo) to run `fetchPromo()` as a mutation and to pass the returned promo to the store action `applyPromo` on success.
**`src/routes/cart/components/`**
- Modified [`<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#CartSummary) to render `<PromoForm />`, a Discount line when the discount is over `0`, and the total minus the discount.
- Added [`<PromoForm />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/PromoForm.tsx#PromoForm) with a field for the code, an Apply button and a message for a failed request.

nodes.impactReason: [`<CartLine />` calls `removeItem()`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L13), and [`removeItem` writes `items` and leaves `promo` as it is](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L20-22). A shopper who removes the last line with "Remove" keeps the applied promo, and the discount is taken off the next item the shopper adds.

waypoints.title: Added the type `Promo`
waypoints.reading: The author added a type `Promo` that has a `code`, a string, and a `percentOff`, a number. [`fetchPromo()`](code:src/api/promo.ts#fetchPromo) returns one. [`CartState`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#CartState) keeps one as `promo`, so that [`selectDiscountCents()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#selectDiscountCents) can read its `percentOff`. No code checks the response against the type: [`request()` casts the JSON to it](code:src/api/client.ts#L24).

waypoints.title: Added `fetchPromo()` to request the promo of a code
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `fetchPromo()` that requests the promo of a code and returns it as a [`Promo`](code:src/api/promo.ts#Promo). `fetchPromo("TEA10")` calls [`request()`](code:src/api/client.ts#L18-25) with `"/promos/TEA10"`, and it passes the code through `encodeURIComponent()` first, so `"A/B"` becomes `"/promos/A%2FB"`. [`request()` throws an `ApiError`](code:src/api/client.ts#L23) for a response that is not ok, and `fetchPromo()` does not catch it. [`useApplyPromo()`](code:src/hooks/use-promo.ts#useApplyPromo) passes the function to `useMutation` as its `mutationFn`, so that the cart can ask the API which discount a typed code gives.

waypoints.title: Modified `CartState` to have a promo
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a type `CartState` that now has:

- `promo`, a [`Promo`](code:src/api/promo.ts#Promo), or `null` when no promo is applied
- `applyPromo`, an action that takes a [`Promo`](code:src/api/promo.ts#Promo) and returns nothing

[`useCartStore`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#useCartStore) gives both a value, and [`selectDiscountCents()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#selectDiscountCents) takes a `CartState`, so that the selector can read `promo` beside `items`.

waypoints.title: Modified `useCartStore` to keep a promo until the cart is cleared
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a store `useCartStore` that now:

- starts with `promo: null`
- sets `promo` to the promo it is given in the new action `applyPromo`
- sets `promo` to `null` in `clear`, with `items: []`

[`useApplyPromo()`](code:src/hooks/use-promo.ts#useApplyPromo) passes `applyPromo` to `useMutation` as its `onSuccess`, so that a fetched promo is kept where [`selectDiscountCents()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#selectDiscountCents) reads it. `addItem` and `removeItem` do not write `promo`. A promo therefore stays applied when a shopper removes every line with [the "Remove" button of `<CartLine />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartLine.tsx#L13-15), and only [`handleConfirm()`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L13-16) removes it, through `clear`.

waypoints.title: Added the constant `PERCENT`
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `PERCENT` with the value `100`. [`selectDiscountCents()` divides by it](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L43), so that a `percentOff` of `10` gives a tenth of the total.

waypoints.title: Added `selectDiscountCents()` to compute the discount of the applied promo
waypoints.reading:
The author added a function `selectDiscountCents()` that returns the discount of the cart in cents. It:

- returns `0` when `promo` is `null`
- returns the result of [`selectTotalCents()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L35-37) times `percentOff`, divided by [`PERCENT`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#PERCENT) and rounded with `Math.round()`, for any other `promo`

A total of 1999 cents with `percentOff: 10` gives `200`. [`<CartSummary />` passes the function to `useCartStore` as a selector](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L9), so that the summary can show the discount and subtract it from the total. The function does not limit `percentOff`: a value of `150` gives a discount over the total.
waypoints.coreChange: This is the rule the pull request exists for: how much a promo takes off the cart. The other changes fetch the promo, keep it in [`useCartStore`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#useCartStore) and show this result in [`<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#CartSummary).

children.label: Shows the promo code field and the Apply button
children.description: When a shopper opens /cart with at least one item in the cart, [`<CartPage />` renders `<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L15), and [`<CartSummary />` renders this component](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L20) above the Discount line and the Total line.

traceNodes.label: Keeps the cart items and the applied promo
traceNodes.description:
Three Entry Points reach this store.

- When a shopper opens /cart with at least one item in the cart, [`<CartPage />` renders `<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L15), and [`<CartSummary />` reads the total, the discount and `clear` from this store](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L8-10). On the same visit, [`<CartSummary />` renders `<PromoForm />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L20), [`<PromoForm />` calls `useApplyPromo()`](code:src/routes/cart/components/PromoForm.tsx#L7), and [`useApplyPromo()` reads `applyPromo` from this store](code:src/hooks/use-promo.ts#L6).
- When the request for a promo succeeds, TanStack Query runs the `onSuccess` of the mutation, which is the action `applyPromo` of this store. The trace assumes this connection: `applyPromo` reaches `useMutation` as a value, and no code calls it by name.
- When a shopper clicks "Empty it", [`handleConfirm()` calls `clear()`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L14), the action that `<CartSummary />` read from this store. The trace assumes this connection too.

traceNodes.label: Requests the promo of a code from the API
traceNodes.description: When a shopper opens /cart with at least one item in the cart, [`<CartPage />` renders `<CartSummary />`](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L15), [`<CartSummary />` renders `<PromoForm />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L20), [`<PromoForm />` calls `useApplyPromo()`](code:src/routes/cart/components/PromoForm.tsx#L7), and [`useApplyPromo()` passes this function to `useMutation` as its `mutationFn`](code:src/hooks/use-promo.ts#L7). No code calls this function by name. TanStack Query runs it when [`handleSubmit()` calls the mutation with the typed code](code:src/routes/cart/components/PromoForm.tsx#L9-12), and the diagram draws no edge for that call.

waypoints.title: Added `useApplyPromo()` to write a fetched promo to the cart store
waypoints.reading:
The author added a function `useApplyPromo()` that returns a mutation, which:

- runs [`fetchPromo()`](code:src/api/promo.ts#fetchPromo) with the code it is called with, as its `mutationFn`
- passes the returned [`Promo`](code:src/api/promo.ts#Promo) to [the store action `applyPromo`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L23-25), as its `onSuccess`

[`<PromoForm />` calls the mutation with the typed code](code:src/routes/cart/components/PromoForm.tsx#L9-12) and reads its `isPending` and `isError`, so that the form holds no request and no store access of its own. When `fetchPromo()` throws, `onSuccess` does not run, so a promo that was applied before stays in the store.
waypoints.coreChange: This is where a promo goes from the API into the cart. The mutation is the only code that runs [the store action `applyPromo`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L23-25), and it runs the action only after a request that succeeded.

waypoints.title: Modified `<CartSummary />` to show the promo form and the discount
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a component `<CartSummary />` that now:

- reads the discount in cents from the store with [`selectDiscountCents()`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#selectDiscountCents)
- renders [`<PromoForm />`](code:src/routes/cart/components/PromoForm.tsx#PromoForm) above the total
- renders a line `Discount:` with the discount when it is over `0`
- renders `totalCents - discountCents` in the line `Total:`, where it rendered `totalCents`

A cart of $19.99 with a promo of 10 percent shows `Discount: $2.00` and `Total: $17.99`. [`<CartPage />` renders the component under the cart lines](code:src/routes/cart/index.tsx#L15), so that a shopper enters a code and reads its result in the same place. `handleConfirm()` did not change, and [the `clear` it calls now also sets `promo` to `null`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L26-28).

waypoints.title: Added `<PromoForm />` to submit a promo code
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<PromoForm />` that:

- keeps the typed text in the state `code`, which starts as `""`
- calls `event.preventDefault()` on submit, then calls the mutation of [`useApplyPromo()`](code:src/hooks/use-promo.ts#useApplyPromo) with `code`
- disables the Apply button while `isPending` is `true`
- renders `That code is not valid.` while `isError` is `true`

[`<CartSummary />` renders it above the total](code:src/routes/cart/components/CartSummary.tsx#L20), so that a shopper can apply a promo to the cart they are looking at. `isError` is `true` for every error the request throws, so [a 500 response](code:src/api/client.ts#L23) shows the same message as a code the API does not know. The component does not check `code` before it submits: an empty field requests `/api/promos/`. The field keeps its text after a promo is applied.

usages.text: return useMutation({ mutationFn: fetchPromo, onSuccess: applyPromo })
const { mutate: applyPromo, isPending, isError } = useApplyPromo()
